 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. For the second time in the span of seven days, Michigan State has had to travel to face one of the toughest teams in college basketball. This time, it comes in the form of a battle with No. 14 Tennessee in the Spartans' first true road test of the season.
 After beating then-No. 2 Duke a week ago, Tom Izzo's job won't get any easier now that they'll be in Knoxville for their first true road game in a hostile environment.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Anyone, any time, any place. Izzo isn't afraid to play anyone and this road game is proof.
 Despite Michigan State being red-hot and earning praise for all the experts, Tennessee is expected to keep this game close at home. Vegas' closing odds are pretty darn close to toss-up status. Michigan State will have to keep fighting to earn respect.
 Odds courtesy of DraftKings as of Tuesday, Nov. 17 . 
 Line: Michigan State -2.5
 Over/Under: 149.5
 Moneyline: Michigan State -142 | Tennessee +120
 Tennessee began the season in the top 10 before falling three spots in Week 1 and then three more this past week in the new rankings after just holding off an upset bid from Tennessee State. The AP voters aren't impressed with the Vols thus far but they're going to have a chance to prove everyone wrong on Tuesday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Food City Center in Knoxville is a tough place to play, but should it really make that much of a difference between a team that led Duke wire-to-wire and one that only beat Tennessee State by five? We're about to find out.
 Score prediction for Michigan State vs. Tennessee
 This one's going to come down to who has the tougher defense and who can win the battle on the glass. Michigan State has one of the most tenacious defenses in college basketball and it was able to hold a team like Duke to just 73 points in a convincing win.
 Tennessee, on the other hand, hasn't played anyone and is still searching for its identity after a cold shooting start from three. It has a solid defenses, but again, it hasn't played a soul.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Michigan State is one of the best rebounding teams in the country and that'll be the difference a second-chance points wear the Volunteers down the stretch of a close game. It'll come down to one final possession, but that's because Tennessee will down a flurry of 3-point prayers in the final couple of minutes.
 Michigan State holds off the Vols for a second ranked win in two weeks to improve to 5-0.
 Final score: Michigan State 73, Tennessee 70
